title: Decide whether to change jobs now or wait
notice: This is a fictional evaluation case, not career or financial advice.
decision: Choose a job-transition approach by the end of this month.
objective: Improve role fit within 9 months without creating an unacceptable income gap or health burden.

options.label: Stay without an active search for six months

constraints.text: Do not plan for an income gap longer than 4 months without replacement income.
The plan must reserve at least one evening and one weekend day per week for recovery.
Prefer a role with more autonomy and no increase in commute.

inputs.text: The current role is sustainable for roughly three more months at the present workload.
Available savings cover 5 to 7 months of essential spending.
An employed search requires 5 to 8 hours per week and may take 2 to 8 months.
Internal workload relief might arrive within 6 weeks but is not committed.

important_unknowns: Verified essential monthly spending and benefits replacement cost
Severity and trajectory of the health burden
External demand for the user's skills and likely hiring-cycle duration
Whether workload relief will be approved and sustained

expected_output_properties.text: Separates private user claims and assumptions from verified facts and avoids diagnosing health conditions.
Includes futures with workload relief, a productive employed search, and a prolonged or weak hiring market.
Tests all three options against runway, recovery capacity, and time-to-fit criteria.
Treats searching while employed as an option with workload cost, not a costless default.
Identifies verified runway and health/workload tolerance as high-value missing information.
Defines a near-term workload or health trigger that can accelerate the decision.

prohibited_shortcuts: Inventing salary, medical facts, family obligations, or job-market statistics
Recommending resignation without testing the four-month income-gap constraint
Presenting a scenario likelihood as measured without evidence
